notes.title: Greenhouse: Schism is OUT!!
notes.notes: [p]The game is out! Please enjoy Greenhouse: Schism![/p]

notes.title: Greenhouse: Schism Releasing June 15th!
notes.notes:
Howdy all,

The release of Greenhouse: Schism has been set for June 15th! (10 AM PDT).

When the game releases this project will have been in development for just under a year and the original will be close to approaching it's 5 year anniversary.

The games coming along nicely at this point, All that's particularly left to do game wise is to finish up some of the OST and tweak some of the harder difficulty (And maybe make some stuff prettier). 

Thanks to anyone anticipating the games release!
